label: Pinkberry
note: Opened January 2005 in West Hollywood by Shelly Hwang and Young Lee; an LA Times lab test found far fewer live cultures than the 10 million per gram the National Yogurt Association requires, and it got the Live and Active Cultures seal on 17 April 2008 after changing the recipe

about.text: California frozen yoghurt chain opened in West Hollywood in January 2005 that revived the 1980s frozen yoghurt craze; customers choose toppings.
